prompt: Create a delicate vertical anime-style watercolor portrait of F-shi, an elegant androgynous young person with pale skin, long platinum-blond hair swept to the side and tied loosely at the nape, and striking heterochromia eyes: one violet eye and one muted green eye. The character is shown from the chest up in a refined autumn mood, facing slightly left while gazing calmly and mysteriously at the viewer. A large white folding fan covers the lower half of the face up to the nose; the fan has pale ivory paper ribs, dark navy struts, and exactly two maple leaves attached near the center-right: one muted green leaf and one reddish-brown autumn leaf. One slender pale hand holds the fan at the lower left with long elegant fingers. Dress the character in a translucent pale lavender kimono or robe with subtle layered folds, white sheer outer fabric, and fine sketch-like linework suggesting flowing sleeves. Use a soft off-white blank background, airy negative space, faint pencil outlines, pastel washes, gentle blush shadows, and refined Japanese illustration aesthetics. The mood should be quiet, graceful, and seasonal, emphasizing autumn, with no visible text, no watermark, and no extra objects.

promptZh: 创作一张精致的竖版动漫风格水彩肖像，主角是 F-shi，一位皮肤白皙、气质中性优雅的年轻人。角色留着长长的铂金色头发，侧分并于颈后松散地束起，拥有一双迷人的异色瞳：一只紫罗兰色眼睛和一只柔和的绿色眼睛。画面呈现胸部以上的特写，营造出精致的秋日氛围，角色微微向左侧身，平静而神秘地注视着观众。一把巨大的白色折扇遮住了从鼻尖以下的半张脸；折扇扇面为象牙白，扇骨为深海军蓝，扇面中右侧贴有两片枫叶：一片柔和的绿色枫叶和一片红褐色的秋叶。一只纤细苍白的手在左下方握住折扇，手指修长优雅。角色身着半透明的淡紫色和服或长袍，带有微妙的层叠褶皱，外层为白色薄纱，细致的素描线条勾勒出飘逸的袖口。背景采用柔和的灰白色留白，营造出轻盈的负空间感，辅以淡淡的铅笔轮廓、柔和的粉彩渲染、细腻的腮红阴影，展现出精致的日式插画美学。整体基调应安静、优雅且富有季节感，强调 autumn 主题，画面中不包含任何可见文字、水印或多余物体。
